notes: Paper presents experimental bounds on temporal oscillations of the fine-structure constant α and electron mass m_e using dynamic decoupling with a trapped 88Sr+ ion. The primary new result is Figure 1, which shows bounds on relative frequency modulation (δf/f₀) as a function of modulation frequency ν from ~10 Hz to MHz range. The paper interprets these bounds in terms of scalar dark matter couplings g_φγ (to photons) and g_φe (to electrons). Data points extracted from Figure 1 represent the bound on d_α = |δα/α|_UB at various frequencies corresponding to scalar DM masses m_φ = 2πν. The bound is currently the only direct constraint on temporal oscillations of fundamental constants in the 10 Hz–MHz range, filling a gap in existing searches. The paper also discusses relaxion DM and boson star scenarios. DM density ρ_DM = 3.1×10⁻⁶ eV⁴ (local solar neighborhood) is assumed for the generic DM analysis. Confidence level is 95% CL as stated in Figure 1 caption.
